name: Jarvis
author: Gustavo von Atzingen
description: Local-first voice assistant for Omarchy: wake word, natural conversation, barge-in, Codex/Claude answers with machine access, live conversation window. Bar widget with status, controls and settings.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant status (on / paused / off) with a hover panel: voice guide, on/off, pause, logs, settings.
